purpose: Close the common nonzero-state object callback reached after platform phase culling.

source.pipeline: raw NE segment import, Ghidra no-analysis annotation, protected-mode decompilation/listing export, NE relocation call-site identity

01F7:1997.name: address_named_common_callback_1997
01F7:1997.calling_convention: near wrapper; object context is ES:DI; CALLF to 01F7:3529 at 1997 and RET at 199C
01F7:1997.inputs_outputs: Forwards the pooled object context to 3529; no return value or caller-consumed flags
01F7:1997.scheduler_position: Installed by 0E06 at object +0x1C and invoked by the 0FA2 nonzero-state pass after 0E96
01F7:1997.object_effects: No object or scheduler write; forwards to the common resource/queue path

01F7:3529.name: address_named_common_callback_3529
01F7:3529.calling_convention: far callback; ES:DI pooled object; RETF at 3586; no caller-consumed flags
01F7:3529.inputs_outputs: Reads object +0x12 as a selector, uses DS:6D8E and DS:6D8A resource records with DS:30D2 stride, rejects FFFF/high-bit/null resource entries, and forwards object/resource coordinates to 34E3
01F7:3529.scheduler_position: Common callback invoked by 0FA2; remains callable after 1DEE clears object +0x18
01F7:3529.object_effects: Publishes no object/lifetime change; forwards one eligible object to the bounded queue writer

01F7:34E3.name: address_named_queue_writer_34E3
01F7:34E3.calling_convention: far helper; AX/BX are object-relative coordinates, CL/CH are selected resource bytes, DX is object +0x12; RETF at 3528
01F7:34E3.inputs_outputs: Subtracts DS:81C0/DS:81C4, calls near 3808, rejects a negative packed CX result, adds DS:81A8/DS:81AC, writes one 16-byte queue record at DS:37DE + DS:37E0*0x10, and increments DS:37E0
01F7:34E3.scheduler_position: Presentation callback nested under 0FA2; after object phase callbacks and before later presentation consumption
01F7:34E3.object_effects: Queue record writes: +0x00 AX, +0x02 BX, +0x04 CL, +0x05=0, +0x06 CH, +0x07=0, +0x08 DX

01F7:3808.name: address_named_coordinate_helper_3808
01F7:3808.calling_convention: near helper; AX/BX coordinates, CL/CH extents; RET at 3867/386E
01F7:3808.inputs_outputs: Clips/rejects the supplied coordinates against DS:81CC and returns CX=FFFF on rejection or a packed nonnegative byte pair on acceptance; AX/BX may be adjusted
01F7:3808.scheduler_position: Near leaf called only by 34E3 in this focused closure
01F7:3808.return_flags: path-dependent flags are not consumed; CX carries the result

stopping_conclusion: The 01F7:1997 -> 3529 -> 34E3 -> 3808 edge is a common presentation queue path. It does not write player state, DS:8812/DS:8816 carry, MAP/descriptor state, scheduler membership, or object phase callbacks. Platform culling at 1DEE therefore has no hidden player-simulation write in this common callback; attached-player/cull membership remains a separate runtime question.
